newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm oil prices stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm oil prices stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil and olein prices were little changed in late trading on Tuesday as market participants stayed on the sidelines, traders said.
One trader in Medan said buyers were reluctant to place firm bids because of a tendency for prices to soften while sellers declined to lower prices on relatively tight raw material supply.
"Participants are looking for fresh leads from a possible tender of crude palm oil on Wednesday or Thursday," he said.
Traders said overall the market was quiet, with crude palm oil prices still offered at around the last tendered price of 1,450 rupiah/kg.
They said nothing much was recorded in the ready olein market, with last prices quoted at 1,450 rupiah/kg in Medan, 1,480 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and 1,500 rupiah in Surabaya.
